summary_1line: After Jayadratha’s death, the Pandavas rejoice while Duryodhana laments the devastation of his army and admits Arjuna’s unmatched prowess.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira embraces the blood‑wounded Bhima and Satyaki while the Pandava army cheers around them on the battlefield.
Duryodhana stands pale and tearful amid heaps of slain warriors, breathing like a wounded serpent after hearing of Jayadratha’s death.
Duryodhana approaches Drona in the war camp at dusk, gesturing toward the devastated battlefield while lamenting the slaughter of kings.
